additional_concerns: The source says both “will take immediate effect” and “will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).” The formula selects the latter without resolving whether the statements concern different measures or coincide in time.

The transition preserves an application process; it does not expressly establish a permanent substantive bar to relief for every change associated with that application. The fixed Effective Date snapshot and treatment after approval, withdrawal or replacement need clarification.
The legally relevant event for assessment_date is unresolved. A calendar comparison alone cannot resolve commencement eligibility.
The two supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata linking them to particular external materials. No catalogue mapping can safely be inferred.

Home-jurisdiction requirements and the classifications of novel features, complex features and possible local policy implications require substantive assessment outside this formula. The formula does not establish those facts.
FALSE establishes only failure of the proposed relief test, not an approval duty or non-compliance. Notification, filing and post-vetting obligations remain outside the result.
